tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search Schematik's public electronics parts catalogue (boards, sensors, displays, modules) by name, brand, part number or use. Returns a JSON list of parts, best matches first; pass a result's slug to get_part for its pinout and price.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: One part from the catalogue by slug, as JSON: name, brand, part number, description, category, an available vendor price (lowest offer in one currency, USD when available, e.g. 'from 4.5 USD'), pinout and a link to its Schematik page. Brand, part number, description, price and pinout can be null whe

tools.name: search_build_guides
tools.description: Search published Schematik build guides: complete projects with parts, wiring and firmware. Leave query empty to list featured guides first. Returns a JSON list of guides with a link and a remixUrl; pass a result's slug to get_build_guide for the full guide.

tools.name: get_build_guide
tools.description: A published build guide by slug as markdown: parts, assembly steps, connections and firmware.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
